security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: mediastream:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self' data: blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Pen notebook where every page is a PDF
bundle.longDescription: Coolmus is a pen notebook for Windows: every page is a PDF in your own folders, you can write on any PDF, and OneNote notebooks can be imported.
